title: Did you know… John stayed near the cross while others fled?
paragraphs: Did you know… John stayed near the cross while others fled?
He didn’t run.
He stayed.

While the sky darkened…
While the crowd roared…
While nails tore through flesh…

Gospel of John tells us something raw—
when others scattered in fear, John stood close enough to hear Jesus breathe His last.
Close enough… to feel the weight of it.
Think about that.

Peter the Apostle denied.
Others disappeared into shadows.
But John?
He remained.

Not because he was braver.
But because he was nearer.
And here’s what we miss—
Closeness to Jesus will cost you something.

You will see things others avoid.
You will feel the heartbreak of obedience.
You will stand in places where comfort dies.
But you will also witness what others never see:
Grace… in its rawest form.

Because at that cross, Jesus didn’t just suffer—
He spoke love.
“Behold your mother.”

Even in agony, He was restoring relationships.
Even in pain, He was giving purpose.
That’s the Gospel.

We ran.
He stayed.

We sinned.
He paid.

We hid.
He hung… in public shame—so we could walk in freedom.

And John?
He saw it.

Not from a distance.
But up close.
So here’s the question—

Will you follow Jesus…
even when it leads you to uncomfortable places?
Or only when it’s safe?

Because the deepest revelations of Christ
are not found in comfort—
They’re found at the cross.
Come closer.
Don’t run.
There is still grace here for you.
